A '''''Munificent''-class star frigate''' served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. It engaged [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[622]]'' over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but was destroyed by flak guns commandeered by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had boarded the CIS [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. The two Jedi first destroyed the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|star frigate's]] bridge, then its midsection, and the engines last.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Munificent''-class star frigate appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|video game]] version of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].
